method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Tech stocks slide on AI valuation doubts; oil jumps after Middle East attacks
Equities.reason: Broad market piece linking geopolitical escalation (Middle East attacks) and a jump in oil to a risk-off move that hit tech/AI/semiconductor stocks. Dominant equities narrative = risk-off driven by geopolitics and AI-valuation doubts, so negative and highly relevant.

Equities.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Climbs on Middle East Flare-Up: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Market wrap emphasizing oil-driven risk-off after US-Iran strikes; reinforces a market-regime shift (higher energy, weaker growth/tech risk appetite). High relevance for broad equities sentiment and sector rotation.

Equities.title: Stock futures fall after U.S. strikes on Iran; Korea's Kospi enters bear market: Live updates
Equities.reason: Real-time futures/market update tying U.S. strikes to immediate risk-off in global index futures and a regional selloff (Kospi enters bear market). Useful as a timely indicator of market sentiment and spillovers into equities.

Equities.title: Big Market Rotation Sends Korean Stocks Tumbling, China Surging
Equities.reason: Describes cross-market rotation (chips/ Korea hit, China strength) driven by AI jitters and repositioning. Reinforces narrative of sector- and region-specific flows rather than a uniform rally — negative for global tech/semis exposure.

Equities.title: As chip sector takes it on the chin, traders bet on a big Nvidia rally
Equities.summary: Shares of Nvidia fought into the green despite a 5% sell-off in chip stocks tracked by the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH).
Equities.reason: Counter-signal within the dominant risk-off: shows concentrated conviction in AI/market leadership names (Nvidia) even as broader chip sector falls. Relevant for positioning within tech but lower relevance to overall market direction.

Equities.title: Exxon Sees $3.7 Billion Profit Surge From War-Driven Oil Rally
Equities.reason: Illustrates sector winners (energy) from geopolitical-driven oil strength. Positive for energy stocks but limited relevance to the broader equity market regime, which is dominated by risk-off and tech weakness.

Rates.title: Stocks end lower; oil, bond yields rise as U.S. scraps waiver on Iran sanctions
Rates.reason: Headline links geopolitical risk and oil shock to a near-term rise in U.S. bond yields. Yields up = negative for bond prices; reasonably topical for rates markets but not a full regime shift.

Rates.title: Japan’s borrowing costs soar to 30-year high on debt fears
Rates.summary: Worries over long-term spending plans help push bond yields to highest since 1996
Rates.reason: Large move in JGB yields and market concern about sovereign financing/long-term fiscal plans is material for global rates and risk premia. Strong negative impulse for bond prices in the JGB complex with spillover potential.

Rates.title: China’s 10-Year Bond Sale Sees Demand Gauge at Record High
Rates.reason: Record-high demand at a sovereign auction is supportive for bond prices (yields down). This is a clear positive rate-side signal for China paper and signals healthy demand/liquidity in the sovereign auction market.

Rates.title: Traders Hedge for Less Hawkish Fed as Hikes Remain Priced In
Rates.reason: Market positioning shifting toward a slightly less hawkish Fed path is modestly supportive for bond prices, though hikes still priced in so the effect is partial; relevant to US curve and Fed expectations.

Rates.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hike seen as moderate tightening – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Derek Halpenny reports that the New Zealand Dollar strengthened after the RBNZ raised its policy rate by 25 bps to 2.50%, the first increase since May 2023. He notes OIS had largely priced the move and more hikes, but MUFG expects only two additional in
Rates.reason: A 25bp RBNZ hike is directly rate-moving for NZ duration and local term structure (yields up → negative for bond prices). Region-specific impact with moderate relevance to global rates via risk/Carry channels.

FX.title: USD/JPY Price Forecast: Dollar remains capped below 162.40 resistance area
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) appreciates against the Japanese Yen (JPY) for the fourth consecutive day on Wednesday, fuelled by the resumption of hostilities in the Middle East and dovish comments from Bank of Japan (BoJ) officials.
FX.reason: USD strength vs JPY driven by renewed Middle East hostilities and dovish BoJ commentary — a clear USD-up / JPY-down narrative with multi-factor support (geopolitics + BoJ). High relevance for USD funding and JPY safe-haven flows.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index holds in range amid ongoing hopes of a negotiated end to the war
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) pulls back to levels a few pips shy of 101.00 during Wednesday’s European session, after being rejected at the 101.20 area earlier in the day, and has turned negative on daily charts.
FX.reason: DXY intraday pullback amid hopes of negotiation reduces immediate USD upside risk. Relevant to broad USD positioning, but lower significance versus clear geopolitical-triggered moves.

FX.title: Dollar at week-high after US resumes Iran strikes; RBNZ hike hoists kiwi
FX.reason: Major market-moving piece: renewed US strikes lift dollar to week highs (strong USD) while RBNZ hike lifts NZD. High relevance — geopolitical-driven USD demand and central-bank divergence are core FX drivers today.

FX.title: US Dollar: Exposure stays elevated – BNY
FX.summary: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that cross-border investors’ Dollar holdings remain close to multi-year highs, driven by strong United States (US) asset exposure with fewer FX hedges.
FX.reason: Institutional dollar exposure near multi-year highs supports continued USD resilience. Broad positioning signal increases persistence of USD strength — meaningful for cross-asset flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Weak tone within defined trading band against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights that USD/JPY is trading firmly after a sharp rise, with intraday bias tilted higher toward 162.70 while major resistance at 163.00 is expected to hold.
FX.reason: Bank commentary confirms JPY underperformance and near-term upside in USD/JPY. Useful trade- and flow-level confirmation of the broader USD/JPY USD-strength narrative.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Sustenance above 20-day EMA backs further upside above 1.3400
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades almost flat at around 1.3355 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The Cable consolidates as investors await the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes of the June policy meeting, which will be published at 18:00 GMT.
FX.reason: Short-term GBP consolidation ahead of FOMC minutes — limited immediate FX impact. Small positive tilt for GBP given technicals, but low relevance versus macro USD drivers.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Weakens below 1.4200 as Oil gains, but technicals still favor upside
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair loses traction to near 1.4175 during the early European trading hours on Wednesday. Renewed US military strikes against Iran have boosted crude oil prices and provide some support to the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) strengthens again
FX.reason: Oil-led CAD strength is offsetting USD moves — USD/CAD softening as crude rises. Commodity-driven CAD moves are directly relevant to USD crosses; relevance medium-high given oil/geo linkage.

FX.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Sticks to hawkish RBNZ-led gains to 0.5710-0.5715 confluence
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains strong positive traction following the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's (RBNZ) first rate hike in three years and reclaims the 0.5700 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: Monetary policy divergence: RBNZ hike is a clear positive for NZD vs USD. High relevance for G10 FX as it demonstrates central-bank-induced USD weakness in specific crosses.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish remarks from RBA’s Hunter lift Australian Dollar
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades 0.23% higher to near 0.6943 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.
FX.reason: RBA hawkish rhetoric supports AUD vs USD. Relevant for AUD crosses and reflects central-bank commentary driving localized USD weakness.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds losses following Consumer Confidence data
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 18,050 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.
FX.reason: IDR weakness against USD on local data — EMFX move that contributes to broader USD demand but is lower relevance relative to G10 and major USD positioning.

Commodities.title: Oil: Gradual downside with security premium – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC Bank’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight that Oil and tech-led equity weakness have driven a stronger US Dollar, higher global yields and softer Gold.
Commodities.reason: OCBC frames a modest downside bias for oil driven by a stronger USD and higher yields, offset by an ongoing security premium. Net impact is mildly negative for oil prices with mid-tier relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver climbs above $60.00 despite US–Iran tensions, Fed minutes in focus
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) attracts some buyers to near $60.35, snapping the two-day losing streak during the early European session on Wednesday. The white metal edges higher amid a softer US Dollar (USD) ahead of the release of the June FOMC meeting Minutes.
Commodities.reason: Near-term silver buying on a softer USD and FOMC minutes-driven flows. Price action is relevant to metals traders but is a routine session-level move, so relevance is moderate.

Commodities.title: Gold: Central bank demand underpins prices – ING
Commodities.summary: ING strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report that Gold has edged lower after an early advance as traders await the June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes, but the metal trades in line with evolving US rate expectations and remains support
Commodities.reason: ING highlights structural central-bank buying as a supportive driver for gold, which has material market implications beyond a single session. This is a meaningful constructive fundamental signal for the gold market.

Commodities.title: Gold bulls seem hesitant as Iran tensions fuel inflation fears and hawkish Fed bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its bid tone heading into the European session on Wednesday and, for now, seems to have snapped a two-day losing streak to sub-$4,100 levels, or the weekly trough touched the previous day.
Commodities.reason: Gold is supported by geopolitical risk and a softer USD but gains are capped by hawkish Fed expectations. Mildly constructive for bullion with session-level relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Prices Jump After Renewed Strikes in Gulf Put Shipping Recovery at Risk
Commodities.reason: Renewed strikes in the Gulf materially revive supply/transport risk for seaborne crude and raise the oil risk premium. This is a significant geopolitical shock with high relevance for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil: Geopolitical risk lifts prices – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent has jumped above $76/bbl as renewed tensions in the Persian Gulf and US strikes on Iran revive supply concerns.
Commodities.reason: ING reports a clear Brent upside response to Persian Gulf tensions and US strikes on Iran. Reinforces a stronger oil supply-risk narrative; high relevance for crude markets.

Commodities.title: WTI holds above $72.00, near two-week high amid fresh US-Iran tensions
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the previous day's strong move up and enters a bullish consolidation phase near a two-week high, touched during the Asian session this Wednesday.
Commodities.reason: WTI consolidation near a two-week high amid US–Iran tensions signals a constructive near-term oil posture. Market-moving but more of a price-action confirmation than new fundamental news.

Commodities.title: China Extends US Soybean Buying Spree as Trade Thaw Continues
Commodities.reason: Sustained Chinese buying is a material demand shock for US soybeans and supports higher grains prices. High relevance given China's outsized role in the soy complex.

Commodities.title: Iranian Oil at Sea Left in Limbo After US Revokes 60-Day Waiver
Commodities.reason: US action on waivers creates immediate uncertainty over Iranian crude flows, tightening effective supply and adding a significant upside risk premium to oil markets.

Commodities.title: Gold Steadies After Fresh US Strikes in Iran Cloud Rate Outlook
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical shocks (US strikes) increase safe-haven demand while also muddying Fed rate expectations — net constructive for gold with above-routine relevance.

Commodities.title: U.S. refining capacity decreased during 2025
Commodities.summary: U.S. operable atmospheric distillation capacity, the primary measure of refinery capacity, totaled 18.2 million barrels per calendar day (b/cd) on January 1, 2026-down over 250,000 b/cd (about 1%) compared with January 1, 2025-according to our latest annual Re
Commodities.reason: A decline in US refining capacity tightens refined-product balances and can support crude and product prices over time. Structural supply-side detail with steady relevance to oil markets.

Crypto.title: Binance taps into Bitcoin holders’ hunger for yield with new covered call yield play
Crypto.reason: Product-level innovation that increases yield options for BTC holders supports demand/retention of on-exchange BTC — constructive for flows but not singularly market-moving.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin under pressure as U.S.-Iran escalation lifts oil
Crypto.reason: Geopolitical risk-off (U.S.-Iran escalation) lifting oil and pressuring risk assets reduces appetite for crypto — a meaningful macro-driven negative flow for BTC.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC to propose crypto rule as soon as this month to ease startups, fundraising
Crypto.reason: Potential regulatory easing around fundraising is a significant positive for the crypto ecosystem and institutional/startup activity — high relevance to industry outlook.

Crypto.title: Coinbase secures UK authorization to offer traditional investments alongside crypto
Crypto.reason: Regulatory approval in the UK enabling a bridge between traditional and crypto products supports institutional distribution and product expansion for the asset class.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's recent macro relief faces a challenge from Japanese interest rates
Crypto.reason: Rising Japanese rates / yield differentials can tighten global liquidity and weigh on risk assets including BTC — a material macro headwind to recent crypto upside.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's U.S. reserve still a work-in-progress as federal agencies hash it out
Crypto.reason: Progress toward a U.S. institutional reserve vehicle is constructive for mainstream adoption, but execution/agency coordination keeps near-term impact limited.

Crypto.title: Vanguard opens search for digital assets leader in sign of evolving crypto strategy
Crypto.reason: Major asset manager hiring for digital assets signals ongoing institutional interest, supportive for long-term adoption though not an immediate market mover.

Crypto.title: EDX Markets raises $76 million in funding round led by SBI Holdings
Crypto.reason: Funding for a US-focused crypto trading venue bolsters market infrastructure and institutional plumbing — positive but modest near-term market impact.

Crypto.title: Former Tether investment chief is looking to sell part of his stake in the stablecoin giant: Bloomberg
Crypto.reason: Insider selling at a major stablecoin issuer can raise questions about backing/liquidity and weigh on stablecoin confidence and short-term flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's July gains may be fleeting as U.S. demand stays weak
Crypto.reason: Weak U.S. demand undermines the durability of recent BTC gains — a straightforward negative signal for price momentum and flows.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin stalls as open interest decline raises questions about rally's staying power
Crypto.reason: Declining derivatives open interest suggests less leverage supporting the rally — negative for momentum and short-term upside persistence.

Crypto.title: Strategy selling hundreds of millions worth of bitcoin raises question about its capital-allocation playbook
Crypto.reason: Large on-chain/entity sales (notably high-profile holders) create tangible supply pressure and investor concern — meaningful negative for market sentiment and price.

Crypto.title: Circle’s USDC is leaving Tether behind in the stablecoin volume race, new data from Visa shows
Crypto.reason: Shift toward regulated stablecoin USDC vs Tether supports higher-quality on-ramps and institutional flows — constructive for market stability and adoption.

Crypto.title: Ethereum developers embrace Vitalik Buterin's long-term vision but urge quicker execution
Crypto.reason: Developer alignment on long-term Ethereum roadmap is constructive for ETH fundamentals; calls for faster execution temper the near-term uplift.
